name: Fusb302B → On Error
description:
An automation to perform when communication with the FUSB302B fails. See [`on_error` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fusb302b/#on_error-trigger).

This automation is triggered when communication with the FUSB302B over I²C fails after boot. The component keeps trying to initialize the chip and triggers `on_connect` once a source is detected again.
